answer: Random mutual audit stops bulk fakes. Each epoch a beacon picks three auditors and a random slice of one identity's work; they re-run the jobs, and any mismatch slashes its 200 POA bond, the echo flagging its cluster for heavier audits. A farmer with 100 fakes must lock 100 x 200 = 20,000 POA, while one honest agent locks a single 200 bond once and earns by doing real work. The ripple: each caught fake raises the audit rate nearby.
